image_defaults.prompt_suffix: Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte near-black ground (#121515) with fine film grain, lit by one soft warm brass-toned light source. Palette: near-black, mist white (#F4F9F9), deep ink-blue (#0C2027), warm brass tones and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.

assets.prompt: A pair of small brass scissors lying beside a blank strip of paper cut cleanly in two, on a dark matte desk, warm brass light from the upper left. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

slides.title: “Welcome to our website.”
slides.lead: Visitors know where they are. Say what you do instead.

slides.title: “We are passionate…”
slides.lead: Show it with specifics: what you do, for whom, and how.

slides.title: “Solutions.”
slides.lead: Name the actual thing you sell.

slides.title: “Best in class.”
slides.lead: Claims need proof. Use a real example instead.

slides.headline: Which one is on your homepage?

caption:
Four phrases to cut from your homepage.

“Welcome to our website.” “We are passionate…” “Solutions.” “Best in class.”

Say what you do, plainly. Message us to begin.
